products.text:
Type: wool runner rug
Use: covering a long floor area, hallways and walkways; hallway, living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, traditional, bohemian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, textured loop pile
Colors: multicolor, warm tan, sage green, slate blue, charcoal, cream outlines
Shape: long narrow runner, repeating quatrefoil Moroccan trellis pattern, cream outlines, low pile, light visual weight
Feel: cheerful, soft, welcoming
Goes with: wood floors, navy or white cabinetry, brass accents; eclectic or transitional rooms

Type: abstract area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, coastal
Materials: low pile woven fibers, flat texture
Colors: cool blue, navy, aqua, ivory white
Shape: rectangular, brushstroke abstract pattern fading from deep blue to ivory, low pile, medium size
Feel: fresh, calm, artistic
Goes with: dark wood floors, cognac leather, white walls; modern or coastal rooms

Type: large medallion wool rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: wool, low pile, fringed ends
Colors: dark charcoal grey field, ivory, tan, beige
Shape: large rectangle, central round floral medallion, dense Persian-style florals, wide ivory border, fringe on short ends
Feel: elegant, refined, grounded
Goes with: dark wood furniture, cream upholstery, warm neutrals; traditional or classic rooms

Type: flatweave cotton area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary, rustic
Materials: flatwoven cotton
Colors: warm red, coral pink, orange, ivory
Shape: rectangular, horizontal stripes with small geometric diamond motifs, flat thin weave, light visual weight
Feel: warm, lively, relaxed
Goes with: light wood floors, beige sofas, leather and terracotta accents; bohemian or southwestern rooms

Type: woven jute chevron rug
Use: covering a large floor area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: rustic, coastal, contemporary
Materials: natural jute, chunky flat weave
Colors: natural tan, dark brown
Shape: large rectangle, all-over herringbone chevron pattern, coarse woven texture, flat and sturdy
Feel: earthy, natural, textured
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; rustic, coastal or farmhouse rooms

Type: wool runner rug
Use: covering hallways and long floor areas; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, coastal
Materials: woven wool, flat textured weave
Colors: seafoam green, light sage, cream
Shape: long narrow runner, subtle speckled heathered texture, no pattern, flat low profile, light visual weight
Feel: calm, airy, natural
Goes with: white floors, light wood benches, natural fibers; coastal, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

Type: floral wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, contemporary, farmhouse
Materials: hand-tufted wool, raised outline texture
Colors: cool grey, ivory
Shape: rectangular, all-over scrolling floral vine pattern in ivory on grey, low pile, medium size
Feel: soft, calm, elegant
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, linen upholstery; transitional or farmhouse rooms

Type: large traditional area rug
Use: anchoring a living area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, classic
Materials: low pile woven fibers, fringed ends
Colors: burgundy red, warm tan, ivory, blue and green accents
Shape: large rectangle, central diamond medallion on tan field, red corners, wide decorative tribal border, fringe
Feel: warm, rich, inviting
Goes with: wood floors, light grey sofas, warm woods; traditional or eclectic rooms

Type: floral wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, tasseled fringe
Colors: charcoal taupe field, beige, ivory, pale blue
Shape: rectangular, central medallion with scattered floral motifs, wide patterned border, chunky tassels on short ends
Feel: cozy, crafted, soft
Goes with: warm neutrals, natural wood, linen; farmhouse or traditional rooms

Type: plaid flatweave area rug
Use: under a dining table or seating area; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fibers
Colors: light grey, pale blue, beige
Shape: rectangular, soft plaid grid pattern, thin flat weave, light visual weight
Feel: calm, airy, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, weathered grey wood, linen chairs; farmhouse or coastal rooms
